Simulation and Digital Twin Chapter 09. Synthetic Data Generation 09.01. Synthetic Data Generation Strategy for Robot AI Synthetic data generation for robot AI is the systematic creation of training, validation, and testing data through simulation rather than direct collection from physical robots. A practical strategy begins by defining which capabilities require synthetic coverage, such as perception, localization, navigation, manipulation, locomotion, or autonomous decision making.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 11 · Chapter 08 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_11_Simulation_and_Digital_Twin/blob/main/Chapter_08_Digital_Twin_Architecture/Chapter_08_Digital_Twi…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 08 · Volume 11 · Chapter 08 · EN Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/08_Vol_11_Simulation_and_Digital_Twin/blob/main/Chapter_08_Digital_Twin_Architecture/Chapter_08_Digital_Twin_Architecture_EN.md Volume 11. Simulation and Digital Twin Chapter 08. Digital Twin Architecture 08.01. Digital Twin Maturity Levels Descriptive to Autonomous A digital twin is not simply a three-dimensional model of a physical robot or facility. It is a continuously connected digital representation that describes the identity, configuration, state, behavior, and operational context of a physical asset. Its value increases as the relationship between the physical system and its digital counterpart becomes more complete and more interactive.

Simulation and Digital Twin Chapter 07. Gazebo and Open Source Sim 07.01. Gazebo Sim vs Classic Gazebo Architecture Differences Gazebo has evolved from the architecture commonly associated with Classic Gazebo into a newer simulation architecture generally referred to as Gazebo Sim. articles.title: Rendering X posts as PNGs in Rust with xeet (no headless browser)
articles.excerpt: I tried xeet, a library that turns an X post into a PNG without using a browser. I'm building a metronome app called Metronome.fm as a side project, and I wanted to show some X posts as cards on its l…
articles.body: I tried xeet , a library that turns an X post into a PNG without using a browser. I'm building a metronome app called Metronome.fm as a side project, and I wanted to show some X posts as cards on its landing page. Embedding them means loading X's script on my page, which I'd rather not do, and taking screenshots by hand is a chore. Then I happened to come across xeet and thought, this looks like exactly what I need. From what I've seen, most tools that turn posts into images open x.com in headless Chromium and take a screenshot. xeet doesn't. It re-implements how X draws a post, from scratch, in Rust. The official site describes it like this: X's own rules. X's fonts, emoji and line breaking, with its own text shaper, bidi engine and rasterizer. Small and fast.

articles.body: Modern enterprise infrastructure rarely lives inside a single trust boundary. A typical production environment spans Google Cloud Platform (GCP) GKE clusters and Shared VPCs, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Transit Gateway spokes and EC2 workloads, perimeter Juniper SRX / Cisco ASA security zones, and on-premises Proxmox VE and Kubernetes bare-metal nodes. While open-source Wazuh SIEM & XDR provides exceptional unified visibility across all of these environments, traditional security operations workflows break down at scale for two reasons: alert fatigue and LLM context-window bloat .

Simulation and Digital Twin Chapter 05. Environment Modeling 05.01. Environment Modeling Overview Indoor Outdoor Aerial Environment modeling is the process of constructing a simulated representation of the physical world in which a robot operates, including its geometry, physical properties, semantic meaning, and dynamic conditions. In robotics simulation, the environment is not simply visual scenery. It provides the spatial and physical context required for perception, localization, navigation, planning, control, and interaction.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 16, 1974: The giant Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico broadcasts humanity's 1st interstellar message
articles.excerpt: On this day in space! Nov. 16, 1974: The giant Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico broadcasts humanity's 1st interstellar message
articles.body: On Nov. 16, 1974, humans sent their first message to the stars in an attempt to contact extraterrestrials. They did this using what was then the largest radio telescope in the world, located at the Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico. A group of scientists led by Frank Drake and Carl Sagan sent their message to the M13 star cluster . The message was written in binary code and contained information about human DNA. It also included figures of a human, the solar system and the Arecibo telescope. The idea was that if any aliens were to receive the signal and figure out how to decode it, they would know where it came from. Because M13 is 25,000 light-years away, it will take 25,000 years for any M13 aliens to hear our message — if they are even out there.

articles.title: Relive Starship’s historic Flight 15 with our best photos from launch and ‘Mechazilla’ tower catch
articles.excerpt: See the most epic photos from SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 test flight and historic launch tower catch.
articles.body: STARBASE, Texas — SpaceX has officially wrapped up the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket, successfully catching the vehicle's upper stage for the first time. Flight 15 lifted off from SpaceX's Starbase facility here in South Texas on Friday (Nov. 13). The mission was billed as the first to bring both of Starship's stages, the Super Heavy booster and Ship upper stage, back to the launch site for recovery. And, while SpaceX was forced to divert Super Heavy's return to an off-shore splashdown (and explosion), the upper stage managed to survive its 22-hour jaunt in orbit and plunge through the atmosphere for a picture-perfect catch by the launch tower back at Starbase.

articles.excerpt: For the 16th consecutive year, NASA has received an unmodified, or “clean,” opinion from an external auditor on its fiscal year 2026 financial statements. The rating is the best possible audit opinion…
articles.body: Credit: NASA For the 16th consecutive year, NASA has received an unmodified, or “clean,” opinion from an external auditor on its fiscal year 2026 financial statements. The rating is the best possible audit opinion, certifying that NASA’s financial statements conform with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for federal agencies and accurately present the agency’s financial position. “Our responsibility at NASA is to be disciplined stewards of the resources entrusted to us by the American people while delivering on the missions they expect from this agency,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman.
